purpose: Check that pre-existing exact JANUS artifacts instantiate the scoped-authority fields naturally without changing their frozen verdicts.

A_scope.F0_id: the frozen formula instance / boundary decomposition used by the artifact
A_scope.Reach: boundary assignments generated by the frozen source/interface semantics; no authority is inferred for unrelated formulas
A_scope.Readout: occupancy generating polynomial / frozen exact future signature
A_scope.Continuation: the specific frozen future formula for formula-scoped merging; the separate universal experiment shows arbitrary future 3-CNF continuation collapses the useful quotient toward identity
A_scope.Capability: the frozen checker/constructor authority at the artifact head
A_scope.Proof: fixed-future grouping proof plus exact checker controls
A_scope.Expiry: changing future formula/continuation contract requires a new signature/proof

instances.lesson: This is a direct positive example of continuation-scoped authority and a negative control against silently universalizing it.

A_scope.Reach: states produced by exact factor splitting and the frozen supported polynomial atom language
A_scope.Continuation: closed-component discharge plus retained boundary interaction under the frozen query-factorization procedure
A_scope.Capability: unate CNF and exact 2-SAT local certification plus frozen factorization checker
A_scope.Proof: random exactness controls, contradiction preservation, boundary-not-dropped gate and selector-family controls
A_scope.Expiry: model-count/witness readout, unsupported mixed connected 3-CNF processing, or changed local atom language requires revalidation

instances.lesson: A closed component can be forgotten only because the exact SAT-existence readout and supported local certificate justify it. Structural simplicity alone supplies no authority.

A_scope.Reach: messages produced by symbolic internal-unate or 2-CNF projection from actual source factors
A_scope.Readout: exact existential boundary relation used for SAT-query continuation
A_scope.Continuation: composition through the still-live boundary under the frozen open-message semantics
A_scope.Capability: internal-unate projection and Davis-Putnam-style exact 2-CNF projection only
A_scope.Proof: independent exactness checker against existential profiles on controls/random cases; unsupported general mixed 3-CNF remains explicit/OPEN
A_scope.Expiry: using the message as a general arbitrary-3CNF projector or for an unproved readout invalidates authority

instances.lesson: This is a concrete source-realizable scoped message: supported factors project exactly while unsupported connected interaction is retained instead of being given fake authority.

A_scope.F0_id: finite frozen canonical formula population for the operational gate, plus universal proof only where separately available
A_scope.Reach: actual canonical formulas mapped into the tested representation fibers
A_scope.Continuation: no broader continuation authority was established; this artifact is a predicate-fiber admission test
A_scope.Capability: identity representation gets semantic authority from injectivity but no polynomial SAT-decider authority; CLV resource profile is quarantined
A_scope.Proof: injectivity-by-construction positive control and explicit mixed-SAT fiber negative control
A_scope.Expiry: a different predicate/readout or stronger algorithmic claim requires a new theorem

instances.lesson: This artifact supplies the fiber component of A_scope and already separates semantic authority from algorithmic capability.

A_scope.Reach: states generated by the exact connected-component/typed-basis procedure
A_scope.Readout: certified conflict or exact retained OPEN typed state
A_scope.Continuation: Horn-to-affine basis exchange localized to connected typed components under the frozen interaction language
A_scope.Capability: frozen Horn/affine consequence exchange; connected multirow interaction remains unsupported
A_scope.Proof: exact controls, alpha-renaming invariance, factorized disconnected-core handling and explicit OPEN obstruction
A_scope.Expiry: new interaction rules or attempts to decide the connected multirow core require a new token

instances.lesson: Factorized OPEN components remain authoritative only as scoped unresolved components; absence of cross-product materialization is not a decision theorem.

observer_noninterference.mapping: Can freeze candidate-visible source bytes and A_scope before delayed labels/observer metadata. It does not provide semantic adequacy itself.

conclusion.meaning: The new formal layer is not merely decorative: several prior exact JANUS results were already implicitly scoped by source, query, continuation or capability. The new token makes those implicit licenses explicit and composable with Dual-Debt.

next_gap.recommended_form: Prove a CAPABILITY_SWITCH_AND_SCOPED_AUTHORITY_COMPOSITION theorem before implementing a multi-language solver.
